bpmn:process.name: What converts into what
bpmn:process.bpmn:documentation: The files that carry a study, and what converts into what. Inside the group, every conversion can be undone without loss: YAML and BPMN XML expand and project into each other, and a picture carries its source and reopens from it. A derived view is exported one way. Drawn for docs/reference.qmd.

bpmn:task.name: Render the picture, its source inside
Reopen from the source inside, never the pixels
Export a derived view, one way
